fusions.name: Tangled Spread
fusions.desc: A lashing strand that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles. Anything struck moves 25% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fine Net
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 3 damage, each with a 25% chance to be [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Lash Tripwire
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to set a tripwire that stays armed for 30 seconds. The first enemy to come within 2 tiles of it sets it off, and it deals 14 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Pulled Tight
fusions.desc: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the strands pull tight and strike it for 34% of your weapon damage per strand (170% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 4 seconds.
